at_rest.evidence: apps/web-platform/infra/cloud-init-git-data.yml write_files: /etc/default/git-data-betterstack and /etc/default/git-data-doppler at 0600 root:root; sentry_dsn remains baked inside /usr/local/bin/git-data-emit at 0755 root:root. Since #7772 the baked ingest token is git-data's OWN source (2734275), not the shared 2457081 four other consumers use.
at_rest.defends_against: a file-read-only primitive held by the non-root `git` account (a path traversal in the transport wrapper, say), for the two 0600 files. Also closes the /proc/<pid>/cmdline channel for both credentials: every POST passes its header via `curl -K -` on stdin, and both redactors read their sed script from a 0600 file rather than an -e operand, so no external process carries a secret in argv (cmdline is mode 444; environ is 400). ALSO, since #7772: CODE EXECUTION as a NON-ROOT account can no longer read user_data from the Hetzner metadata endpoint. A host-local nftables rule (write_files /usr/local/bin/git-data-nftables.sh + git-data-nftables.service, armed by a runcmd `systemctl enable --now`) drops 169.254.169.254 for `meta skuid != 0`. Measured at #7772 on the prior host image (Ubuntu 24.04 / nftables v1.0.9); not re-measured after the 2026-10-11 rebirth: root still reaches the endpoint, non-root is dropped, and an un-ruled control address still reaches. Root is exempt so cloud-init's own datasource is unaffected.
at_rest.does_not_defend: CODE EXECUTION AS ROOT, which reads user_data from the metadata endpoint exactly as before — the #7772 nftables drop is scoped to non-root UIDs by design (ADR-198's own wording), so it narrows this from 'any account' to 'root only'. Also does not defend the 0755 sentry_dsn copy, which the `git` account can read today, nor a FILE-READ primitive against /etc/default/git-data-doppler by anything that can read root-owned 0600 files.
